name: avatar
summary: A round picture or initials that stands for a person, such as the account button, a post author or a collaborator.
useWhen: A person is shown beside their content, such as a post author or a project owner.

alternatives.name: badge
alternatives.when: the item is a label, not a person

rules.do: Give every avatar initials as a fallback, so a missing photo still identifies the person.
rules.dont: Leave an empty grey circle when the photo fails to load.

rules.do: Show the person's name next to the avatar the first time they appear.
rules.dont: Rely on a face alone to identify someone.

a11y: Give the image `alt` text with the person's name; leave it empty when the name is printed beside it.
Initials are white on the inset grey, which meets 4.5:1.
